status: Frozen before examining new model-comparison outputs
purpose: Diagnose the same-transition adjacent-order discrepancy; not fit a cosmic-time law.
data: All 17 previously selected native ESPRESSO exposures and unchanged final masks
gas_template: Previously saved null_cross 45-component FeII gas model, held fixed
continuum: Profile independent amplitude, linear slope and additive zero for every exposure/order/trace row
kinematics: One common velocity per exposure; optional constant lower-minus-upper order velocity difference
lsf: One equivalent-RMS Gaussian FWHM per order, shared across exposures and traces; bounds [1.6,2.6] km/s
positive_centered_asymmetric_kernel: 0.8 N(-0.2 d,sigma_g^2)+0.2 N(0.8 d,sigma_g^2), sigma_g^2=(FWHM/2.354820045)^2-0.16 d^2, d=1.2 cbrt(a) km/s; a in [-1,1]. Unit area, zero centroid, fixed total variance, third central moment=0.165888 a (km/s)^3.
models: G0: Gaussian LSF, no order offset
G1: Gaussian LSF, one order offset
A0: centered asymmetric LSF per order, no order offset
A1: centered asymmetric LSF per order, one order offset
optimization: Matched pixels/nuisances. Gaussian starts at previous primary exposure velocities and nominal widths; asymmetric starts at a=(0,0),(0.5,-0.5),(-0.5,0.5). Preserve all starts, select minimum successful objective; record bounds and Jacobian degeneracy.
checks: offset standard error and correlation with asymmetry
held-out 2019-2020 exposures: fit shape/calibration on 2018 exposures then freeze shape/calibration and refit only held-out common exposure velocities and row continua
interpretation: This family is a bounded sensitivity experiment, not a measured ESPRESSO instrumental response. Gaussian-width changes do not probe asymmetry. A zero-centroid LSF avoids exact kernel translation but cannot eliminate blend/shape/offset degeneracy. No discovery p-value or causal attribution from flexibility alone. No model selected only to remove the offset.
